decisionBox.changed: Position moves from HOLD to ADD, and the reason is mechanical rather than a change of view. Midnight's 77,000.0 reduce gate FIRED at last, on the 08:00Z hourly bar which closed 76,812.5 - 187.5 points through the gate - after six consecutive publications in which it never once fired. The futures short that midnight was carrying from 77,346.4 had take-profits resting at 77,000.0 and 76,880.1 and the session traded through both, so the directional bet has been collected by the book rather than by a decision. What is left is a spot core with no hedge in front of it, 39.64 USDT of idle cash, and a completed, measured long flush at 76,600/76,500 with a verified bullish RSI divergence on the 15m. That combination is a small DCA tranche, not a new short into oversold.

liquidation.note: 561,155 USD of measured LONG liquidations across 62 separate fills, the largest single bucket on the OKX tape and 75.8 percent of all forced selling in the window. These fired between 09:24Z and 11:02Z as price lost the 76,700 shelf. Read it as fuel SPENT, not fuel waiting - the leveraged longs that were going to be flushed here have been flushed, which is exactly why price could recover 265 points off the low so quickly.

178,746 USD measured across 38 fills, including the newest print on the entire tape: a long liquidation stamped 2026-09-13T11:02:38Z at a bankruptcy price of 76,495.4, 57 minutes before this report. This is the exact low of the session and of the 24-hour band. It is the floor that has been tested and held once.

NO fresh short-side liquidations were measured anywhere above spot in this window - all 100 fills on the tape were long liquidations and the short-side total is exactly zero USD. The 627,637 USD that fired at this shelf on 12 September is stale and spent. This entry is carried only to mark where the last upside fuel sat; treat it as an empty ceiling, not a magnet.

scalpContext.intradayBias: Short-biased but late to it, and that is the trap. The box has shifted down a full 700 points from midnight: the FLOOR is 76,500.0, today's low, where 178,746 USD of longs were force-sold and where the newest fill on the entire tape printed at 76,495.4. The CEILING is the broken daily EMA20 at 77,043.2, now overhead resistance for the first time in this sequence, with the 15m EMA50 at 77,025.5 sitting 17.7 points beneath it - a two-average wall inside eighteen points. Between them the 15m EMA20 at 76,846.4 is the near-term pivot, only 81.4 points above spot. Chasing short here means selling a 1H RSI of 29.60 into a verified bullish divergence with every measured liquidation magnet already discharged below; chasing long means buying under four bearish-stacked hourly averages. Both edges are worth more than the middle.

calibration.rollingRecord: The streak is over. After SIX consecutive publications in which the 77,000.0 reduce gate never fired - 11 Sep endday through 13 Sep midnight, with the closest wicks at 77,063.1 and 77,064.9 - it fired this morning on the 08:00Z hourly close at 76,812.5, clearing the gate by 187.5 points. The add gate did NOT fire for a seventh straight time: 77,528.3 against a session high of 77,203.6, short by 324.7 points. The 76,001.0 invalidation was not approached, the session low holding 499.0 points above it. Resting stops: midnight declined one, and for the first time in this sequence that declination was WRONG in direction if not in cost - a stop under the 77,063.1 low would have filled on the way down.
calibration.note: Midnight called this correctly and the record should say so plainly. It published range at 46 percent with a bearish tilt at 31 versus 23, held the futures short from 77,346.4 rather than covering it into the compression, and wrote that what the 77,000.0 gate really guarded was the daily EMA20 at 77,043.2. Both broke, in that order, within six hours. The short's take-profits at 77,000.0 and 76,880.1 were both traded through - the session low of 76,500.0 cleared the deeper one by 380.1 points - so the position was collected by the book rather than abandoned. The one thing midnight under-weighted was magnitude: it framed the risk as a gate test, and what arrived was a 703.6-point directional break with 739,902 USD of longs force-sold into it.
